name: megascenes-wedding-invitation
description: Design wedding invitations, save the dates, RSVP and thank-you cards with the couple's names, the date and the venue, in the style you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give the couple's names, the date and the venue you want printed, the card and the style: elegant floral, minimal modern, rustic, boho, classic, gold foil, watercolor. Choose an invitation, a save the date, an RSVP card or a thank-you card. You get the card with your words set in the design, portrait to print or tall to send from your phone.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For couples, families and wedding organizers.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or collect replies. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design wedding invitations and save the dates
RSVP and thank-you cards in the same style
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: An elegant floral wedding invitation for Giulia & Marco, 14 June 2027, Villa Rosa
A minimal save the date for Sara and Tom, September 2027
A rustic thank-you card from Anna and Luca

positive.prompt: An elegant floral wedding invitation for Giulia & Marco, 14 June 2027, Villa Rosa. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one wedding invitation needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A minimal save the date for Sara and Tom, September 2027. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a wedding invitation here?
positive.expected_behavior: The wedding invitation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A rustic thank-you card from Anna and Luca with the words Thank you for celebrating with us. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my wedding invitation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my wedding invitation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
